data.name: Primary Copper Balance Objective
data.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat-dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Objective
data.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Objective
data.text: Assess steady-state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Objective
data.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Steady-State PK Objective
data.text: Determine the steady-state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

data.name: Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated-dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Dose Response Copper Balance Objective
data.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Copper Balance Objective
data.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and LBC Objective
data.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Dose Proportionality Objective
data.text: Assess dose proportionality at steady state of doses of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Plasma Copper:Molybdenum Ratio Objective
data.text: Assess effects ALXN1840 on copper:molybdenum ratio in plasma at steady state in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Urine and Feces Copper:Molybdenum Ratio Objective
data.text: Assess the effects of repeat-dose ALXN1840 on copper:molybdenum ratio in urine and feces in participants with WD

data.name: Primary Copper Balance Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change from Baseline Endpoint
data.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Endpoint
data.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Endpoint
data.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink, and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Endpoint
data.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

data.name: Secondary Steady-State PK Parameters Endpoint
data.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF-molybdenum

data.name: Safety Endpoint - TEAEs and SAEs
data.text: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs)

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Clinical Laboratory Assessments
data.text: Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis)

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Physical Examinations
data.text: Physical examinations

data.name: Safety Endpoint - ECG
data.text: Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12-lead ECG

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Vital Signs
data.text: Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

data.name: Exploratory Dose Response Copper Balance Endpoint
data.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Copper Balance Endpoint
data.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and LBC Endpoint
data.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

data.name: Exploratory Dose Proportionality Endpoint
data.text: Based on PK parameters

data.name: Exploratory Plasma Copper:Molybdenum Ratio Endpoint
data.text: Measure plasma copper:molybdenum ratios at steady state compared with predose

data.name: Exploratory Urine and Feces Copper:Molybdenum Ratio Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily copper:molybdenum ratio in urine and feces at steady state compared with predose baseline

data.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 15 mg/day
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease (WD), both treatment-experienced (standard of care therapies or ALXN1840) and treatment-naïve, enrolled in the study (All Enrolled Participants (Single-Arm, Open-Label Population; approximately 10 participants)) Summary measure: Mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean and variability measures across participants during accumulation and steady-state collection periods).

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction (e.g., to 15 mg every other day) or temporary interruption of ALXN1840 due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the 15 mg/day collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature study discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study prior to completing the 15 mg/day accumulation or steady-state collection periods

intercurrentEvents.name: Protocol deviation in diet control
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant deviates from the copper-controlled diet during inpatient collection periods, affecting copper intake measurements

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete collection period data
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to complete the minimum 3-day collection period for food, drink, feces, or urine sampling required for copper balance calculation

data.treatment: ALXN1840 15 mg/day (single-arm, no comparator; within-participant assessment during accumulation and steady-state periods)
data.analysisPopulation: All Enrolled Participants (Single-Arm, Open-Label Population; approximately 10 participants)
data.variableOfInterest: Mean daily copper balance measured as the calculated difference between copper intake (food and drink) and copper output (feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation (Days 1-8) and steady-state periods for the 15 mg/day dose
data.summaryMeasure: Mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean and variability measures across participants during accumulation and steady-state collection periods)

data.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 30 mg/day
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease (WD), both treatment-experienced and treatment-naïve, who have completed the 15 mg/day period and been titrated to 30 mg/day (All Enrolled Participants Who Received 30 mg/day (Single-Arm, Open-Label Population)) Summary measure: Mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean and variability measures across participants during accumulation and steady-state collection periods at 30 mg/day).

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to titrate to 30 mg/day due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study due to safety concerns identified by the Safety Review Committee (SRC) review through Day 23, preventing titration to 30 mg/day

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption at 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 30 mg/day due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the 30 mg/day collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature study discontinuation during 30 mg/day period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study prior to completing the 30 mg/day accumulation or steady-state collection periods (Days 31-39)

intercurrentEvents.name: Protocol deviation in diet control during 30 mg/day period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant deviates from the copper-controlled diet during the 30 mg/day inpatient collection periods, affecting copper intake measurements

data.treatment: ALXN1840 30 mg/day (single-arm, no comparator; within-participant assessment during accumulation and steady-state periods at 30 mg/day)
data.analysisPopulation: All Enrolled Participants Who Received 30 mg/day (Single-Arm, Open-Label Population)
data.variableOfInterest: Mean daily copper balance measured as the calculated difference between copper intake (food and drink) and copper output (feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for the 30 mg/day dose (Days 31-35 and Days 36-39)
data.summaryMeasure: Mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean and variability measures across participants during accumulation and steady-state collection periods at 30 mg/day)

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change from Baseline Estimand - ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease (WD), both treatment-experienced and treatment-naïve, with a valid pretreatment baseline copper balance measurement (Days -4 through -1) (All Enrolled Participants with Baseline and Post-Baseline Copper Balance Data) Summary measure: Change from baseline in mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean change and variability measures for each collection period versus pretreatment baseline).

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete pretreatment baseline collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not complete the full 4-day pretreatment baseline collection period (Days -4 through -1), resulting in missing or incomplete baseline copper balance data

intercurrentEvents.name: Zinc therapy washout non-compliance
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has not been off zinc therapy for the required minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1, potentially confounding baseline copper balance measurements due to residual metallothionein upregulation effects

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during treatment collection periods
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 during the treatment collection periods, affecting the copper balance measurement at the intended dose level

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature study discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing one or more post-baseline collection periods

data.treatment: ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day versus pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) within the same participants
data.analysisPopulation: All Enrolled Participants with Baseline and Post-Baseline Copper Balance Data
data.variableOfInterest: Change in mean daily copper balance from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) to ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day)
data.summaryMeasure: Change from baseline in mean daily copper balance (descriptive summary: mean change and variability measures for each collection period versus pretreatment baseline)
